svg.title: A-420 South Elevation — Scheme C “Facet”
svg.text: 1.95 m DEEPEST · 0.90 m SHALLOWEST · 14.9 m² A FLOOR
THE BALCONY CURVE IN PLAN — IT CANNOT SHOW IN ELEVATION
Masonry wall cut by section — 200 mm
Internal stud or block partition, 120 mm
Single leaf door, swing shown to opening side
Glazed opening — arched head where noted
Element above the cut plane (pergola, slab
in the underside of the nosing
1. Preliminary — the exterior only. The plans, site plan and
section are agreed at P14 and nothing here changes them:
same five levels, same 9.50 × 13.50 m footprint, same 1.00
m setbacks, same openings. Only the skin differs between
2. Every opening drawn here is read from the plan it belongs
to rather than redrawn, and checks.py fails the build if
an elevation ever shows one the plan does not have.
3. Scheme C is scheme A's skin exactly — warm limestone,
cove-lit slab nosings, glass balustrades, planting, the
same arched ground floor. Only the balcony curve differs,
which is the whole point of putting it beside A.
4. The curve is the serpentine built out of straight runs:
2.40 m flat at 1.95 m deep at each end, a flat waist at
0.90 m in the middle, and 1.20 m radiused transitions
between. Every joint is a tangent, so from the street the
eye still reads one continuous edge.
5. Two things recommend it over the true serpentine. The
formwork is straight for 7.10 m of the 9.50 m span rather
than curved end to end. And because the deep runs are flat
rather than passing through their depth, it carries 14.9
m² a floor against the serpentine's 12.8 — 8 m² more over
6. It still costs area against the curve drawn today: 17.4 m²
a floor becomes 14.9. Adopting it re-issues A-000 and
A-101 to A-104, which carry the balcony in plan.
7. The balconies do not wrap the corner: the 1.00 m setbacks
forbid anything projecting west, north or east, so the
cantilever stays on the street frontage.
Preliminary design issue — not for construction.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
P12 2026-10-07 bedrooms numbered 1-11; all five floors issued as final draft
P13 2026-10-07 site plan redrawn for the detached villa
P14 2026-10-07 section A-A recut through the east strip, and marked on every plan
